categories.name: Apparel
categories.description: Clothing, shoes, hats, accessories, and other wearable products
categories.bestPractices:
## Apparel best practices

### Detail page structure
- Model shots (1-2 images)
- Close-ups of fabric, stitching, and hardware
- Size chart
- Styling suggestions
- Care instructions

### Copy style
- Emphasize materials and craftsmanship
- Show realistic usage scenarios
